metadata.name: Compliance Admin
metadata.description: Compliance administration for one database. Can manage the database's compliance schemas, read GLOBAL schemas and bind them (not edit them), bind and unbind schemas on the database and its assets, trigger evaluations, release quarantined assets, grant and revoke exceptions, and approve/reject the database's cascades. Read-only on the database and its assets. Grants no asset pages: evaluation history and exception revocation are on the database compliance overview.

variables.name: DATABASE_ID
variables.description: The databaseId to scope compliance permissions to

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-compliance-api-routes
constraints.description: Allow API access to compliance endpoints

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-database-list-route
constraints.description: Allow the database list route only (exact path), so the Databases page lists {{DATABASE_ID}} and links to its compliance page

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-compliance-schemas
constraints.description: Allow management of the database's compliance schemas

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-compliance-schemas-global
constraints.description: Allow read of GLOBAL compliance schemas (bindable, not editable)

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-compliance-evaluations
constraints.description: Allow viewing and triggering compliance evaluations in {{DATABASE_ID}}, and revoking exceptions

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-compliance-cascades
constraints.description: Allow read, approval and rejection of the database's cascades

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-compliance-bindings
constraints.description: Allow binding and unbinding compliance schemas in {{DATABASE_ID}}, on the database and on its assets

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-assets-readonly
constraints.description: Allow read access to assets in {{DATABASE_ID}}, which binding a compliance schema to an asset requires

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-database-readonly
constraints.description: Allow read access to the {{DATABASE_ID}} database entity, which binding a compliance schema to it requires
